method: ttf.js: (3,1) cmap format 4 of each TTF in C:/Windows/Fonts, code points folded back to bytes as Windows-1252 maps them (U+0000-00FF = the byte itself, the 27 cp1252 code points of 80-9F = their byte); per code: glyph id, advance (hmtx), sha1 of the raw glyf bytes. Same design = same 4-digit number in the family name.
